projects.name: Enovum Data Centers acquisition (Montreal Tier 3 datacenter)
projects.quote: The acquisition vertically integrated Bit Digital’s HPC operations with a 4MW Tier 3 datacenter in Montreal that is fully leased to a plurality of colocation customers.

projects.name: Pointe-Claire, QC Tier-3 data center expansion
projects.quote: On December 27, 2024, the Company acquired a 160,000 sq. ft. site in Pointe-Claire, QC for a planned 5MW Tier-3 data center expansion.

projects.name: Cerebras Systems built-to-suit colocation (Enovum-developed site)
projects.quote: In February 2025, the Company, through its newly rebranded HPC business WhiteFiber, Inc., secured a five-year colocation agreement to provide 5MW (IT load) of built-to-suit data center ● infrastructure with Cerebras Systems, a leading accelerator of generative AI.

projects.name: Boosteroid GPU MSA
projects.quote: The Company finalized an initial order of 300 GPUs, projected to generate ● approximately $4.6 million in revenue over the five-year term.

projects.name: DNA Fund H200 GPU MSA
projects.quote: On December 30, 2024, the Company signed a Master ● Services Agreement (MSA) with DNA Fund for services utilizing 576 H200 GPUs over 25 months, representing $20.2 million in total revenue.

projects.name: First customer B200 GPU agreement
projects.quote: In January 2025, the Company entered into a new agreement to supply its first customer for an additional 464 B200 GPUs for a period of eighteen months.
